agile.title: Agile projects
agile.subtitle: Plan, prioritize, and follow your teams' work with a Scrumban workflow built into AJR DATA.
agile.createProjectHint: The project key identifies its epics, stories, and tasks.
agile.projectKeyHint: 2–10 alphanumeric characters; must start with a letter.
agile.emptyProjectsHint: Create a workspace to organize epics, user stories, sprints, and the team's board.
agile.searchItems: Search by key, title, or assignee…
agile.noActiveSprintHint: Create a sprint and select the cards the team will work on.
agile.noSprintGoal: No goal has been set for this sprint yet.
agile.noItemsYet: There are no cards in this project yet.
agile.backlogDesc: Prioritize pending work and select the stories that will enter upcoming sprints.
agile.boardDesc: Move cards between statuses, spot blockers, and keep the team's workflow visible.
agile.epicsDesc: Group stories by objective, track progress, and keep epics open while work remains.
agile.noEpics: There are no epics yet. Create one to group related stories.
agile.sprintsDesc: Configure one-to-four-week sprints, start one at a time, and decide what happens to unfinished work when closing.
agile.confirmCarry: Close {{name}} and move unfinished cards into the next sprint? Keys and history will be preserved.
agile.confirmBacklog: Close {{name}} and return unfinished cards to the backlog? Keys and history will be preserved.
agile.sprintCarryCompleted: Sprint closed. Pending cards were moved to the next sprint.
agile.sprintBacklogCompleted: Sprint closed. Pending cards were returned to the backlog.
agile.noSprints: No sprints have been planned yet.
agile.timelineDesc: Review sprint chronology, progress, and outstanding due dates.
agile.noTimeline: Create sprints to start building the timeline.
agile.teamDesc: Assign project-specific functions without changing global AJR DATA account permissions.
agile.confirmRemoveMember: Remove {{name}} from the team? Their assignments will be cleared.
agile.noMembers: No members have been assigned to this project yet.
agile.roleScopeHint: Scrum roles are project-specific. Actions are also validated by the backend; hiding a button is not the security control.
agile.importDesc: Load epics, stories, tasks, and assignees from Excel or CSV with validation before saving.
agile.importFileHint: Supports .xlsx and .csv up to 5 MB and 2,000 rows. A preview is shown first; errors block the entire import.
agile.duplicatePolicy: When type and title already exist
agile.importHeaders: Recognized columns: Title, Type, Description, Epic, Priority, Status, Points, assignee email, Sprint, Acceptance criteria, and Due date. Epics can be referenced by key or title.
agile.previewTruncated: Only the first 100 rows are shown. The server validated every row in the file.

metrics.backlogHint: Cards not assigned to a sprint

agile.confirmArchive: Archive {{key}}? The card will leave active views but its history will be kept.
agile.writeComment: Write a comment for the team…
agile.noHistory: No events have been recorded yet.
agile.historyAuditHint: Important card changes are recorded along with the user who made them.

errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Check the values and try again.
errors.loadWorkspace: Could not load all project data.

agile.googleSheetHint: The sheet must allow view access by link. Private sheets require an additional authenticated integration.
agile.emptyBacklog: There are no pending stories in the backlog.
agile.assignedRoleHint: Functional role responsible for this card; independent of the assigned person.
agile.reorderBacklogHint: Drag stories to adjust their priority.
agile.closeReviewHint: Completed items stay in history. Select unfinished items to move to the destination sprint; the rest return to the backlog.
agile.duplicateCounts: New: {{created}}. Duplicates: {{duplicates}} (skipped or updated per policy).
